allowed_with: same mechanism coded across at least two editions

not_allowed: uncaptured historical descriptions treated as absence
cross-paper speedup arithmetic across unequal systems

missingness_policy: Record missing source text and missing fields separately.
Do not treat inaccessible historical descriptions as negative evidence.
Report denominators for inventory, accessible sources, coded records, condition-complete records, and independently reviewed records.
Run sensitivity analysis over plausible missing records before directional claims.
If a gate cannot be met, publish an insufficient-evidence result instead of a directional claim.

direction_gates.promotion_test: Held-out design improvement at equal correctness, synthesis, model-call, retry, and wall-clock budgets.
Movement-aware benefit survives matched workload, quality target, capacity, bandwidth, topology, and migration cost.
Useful throughput or correctness remains improved after declared protection, detection, recovery, and residual-risk costs.
Fast physical feedback improves feasible decisions against held-out higher-fidelity simulation or measurement.
Adaptive feedback beats a static or nonadaptive baseline at equal total sensing, calibration, and evaluation budget.
Independent reruns preserve the result or ranking under versioned evaluator semantics.

current_boundary.reason: Current editions have unequal source depth, selected coding, substantial historical missingness, and zero independent verdicts.
